title: QueerBench: Quantifying Discrimination in Language Models Toward Queer Identities

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Masked Language Modeling (MLM) sentence completions on neutral templates containing queer vs. non-queer nouns related to sexual and romantic attraction, using sentiment analysis (AFINN), hate speech lexicons (HurtLex), and toxicity detection (Perspective API).

Evaluating Masked Language Modeling (MLM) sentence completions on neutral templates containing gender identity nouns and diverse pronouns (binary, neutral, and neo-pronouns), using sentiment analysis, hate speech lexicons, and toxicity detection.
